Accessibility Is Not Enough. So… What Is?

We’re excited to announce another must-see session at WPAD 2026:

Accessibility Is Not Enough: What We Learned Building the Website for The Dot Experience

Featuring Carl Michel, Melody Partain, and Danielle Burton, this session takes us behind the scenes of building a digital experience where accessibility was only the starting point.
